description: You dont need experience everyone can join I just need some team members who are passionate about this hackathon
summary:
For the "Earth System Trend Detective" challenge, our team, Raisin the bar, explored long-term environmental changes using NASA Earth observation data. We created a slide presentation that breaks down climate trends to show how regional water levels and ecosystems are shifting over time.

A key part of our project was demonstrating the ethical and responsible use of Super Intelligence (SI) tools in scientific research. As outlined in our slides, we made sure to properly disclose our AI tools, keep our materials open-source, and strictly use AI to complement real NASA data rather than inventing or hallucinating facts.

This project matters because it shows how people can use modern AI tools responsibly to interpret vital climate data. By presenting this information clearly in our slide deck, we aim to make Earth science more accessible while maintaining strict scientific accuracy.
